title: luciliocline plicatifolia
intro: Luciliocline plicatifolia, commonly known as the "Butterfly Pea", is a perennial flowering plant native to Australia. This plant is known for its vibrant blue flowers, which have been used in traditional medicine for centuries. The health benefits of Luciliocline plicatifolia include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cognitive function, and aid in the management of stress and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and neuroprotective effects.
